communication_feedback: The communication in this round shows some effort to share suspicions and engage in discussion, but it lacks clear reasoning and alignment. Players are quick to accuse each other without providing substantial evidence or logical arguments. While there is some attempt to gather information, the discussion is fragmented and lacks a strategic focus. Good team members do not appear to be working effectively together, and there is no clear progression toward consensus on who to vote out. Deception detection is weak, as accusations are based more on subjective impressions than on identifying inconsistencies or lies.
